{
    "content": "<p>Since the <a href=\"http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/bb802730.aspx\">MSDN\ndocumentation for Default Custom Action Loacations and IDs</a> is unreliable\n(they look to have copy+pasted the information from the SharePoint 2007\ndocumentation), our only sure bet is to browse the file system and find the\ncustom action IDs and groups ourselves.</p>\n<p>I had need of this information today, and found the items from the site settings\npage located at:</p>\n<p><code>C:\\Program Files\\Common Files\\Microsoft Shared\\Web Server Extensions\\14\\TEMPLATE\\FEATURES\\SiteSettings\\SiteSettings.xml</code></p>\n<p>For those looking specifically for it, here is the custom action for &quot;Delete\nthis site&quot;:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-xml\">&lt;CustomAction\n    Id=&quot;DeleteWeb&quot;\n    GroupId=&quot;SiteTasks&quot;\n    Location=&quot;Microsoft.SharePoint.SiteSettings&quot;\n    Rights=&quot;ManageWeb,BrowseUserInfo&quot;\n    Sequence=&quot;40&quot;\n    Title=&quot;$Resources:core,SiteSettings_DeleteWeb_Title;&quot;\n    Description=&quot;$Resources:core,SiteSettings_DeleteThisSite_Tooltip;&quot;&gt;\n    &lt;UrlAction Url=&quot;\\_layouts/deleteweb.aspx&quot; /&gt;\n&lt;/CustomAction&gt;\n</code></pre>\n<p>If you're looking for that custom action, you're probably wanting to hide it.\nHere's the xml you'll need in your elements file:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-xml\">&lt;HideCustomAction\n    Id=&quot;HideDeleteWeb&quot;\n    GroupId=&quot;SiteTasks&quot;\n    HideActionId=&quot;DeleteWeb&quot;\n    Location=&quot;Microsoft.SharePoint.SiteSettings&quot;&gt;\n&lt;/HideCustomAction&gt;\n</code></pre>\n",

        "rawInput": "\nSince the [MSDN\ndocumentation for Default Custom Action Loacations and IDs](http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/bb802730.aspx) is unreliable\n(they look to have copy+pasted the information from the SharePoint 2007\ndocumentation), our only sure bet is to browse the file system and find the\ncustom action IDs and groups ourselves.\n\nI had need of this information today, and found the items from the site settings\npage located at:\n\n`C:\\Program Files\\Common Files\\Microsoft Shared\\Web Server Extensions\\14\\TEMPLATE\\FEATURES\\SiteSettings\\SiteSettings.xml`\n\nFor those looking specifically for it, here is the custom action for \"Delete\nthis site\":\n\n```xml\n<CustomAction\n    Id=\"DeleteWeb\"\n    GroupId=\"SiteTasks\"\n    Location=\"Microsoft.SharePoint.SiteSettings\"\n    Rights=\"ManageWeb,BrowseUserInfo\"\n    Sequence=\"40\"\n    Title=\"$Resources:core,SiteSettings_DeleteWeb_Title;\"\n    Description=\"$Resources:core,SiteSettings_DeleteThisSite_Tooltip;\">\n    <UrlAction Url=\"\\_layouts/deleteweb.aspx\" />\n</CustomAction>\n```\n\nIf you're looking for that custom action, you're probably wanting to hide it.\nHere's the xml you'll need in your elements file:\n\n```xml\n<HideCustomAction\n    Id=\"HideDeleteWeb\"\n    GroupId=\"SiteTasks\"\n    HideActionId=\"DeleteWeb\"\n    Location=\"Microsoft.SharePoint.SiteSettings\">\n</HideCustomAction>\n```\n",
        "url": "/posts/2011-04-05-sharepoint-2010-custom-action-ids-for-site-settings-page/",
        "outputPath": "./dist/posts/2011-04-05-sharepoint-2010-custom-action-ids-for-site-settings-page/index.html"
    },
